amplitude_gauge_and_score.amplitude_gauge: z_i -> z_i+c from the Q derivative of the common boundary-field normalization C1(Q)
amplitude_gauge_and_score.projection: subtract z at lambda=1/3; equivalently GLS-project the raw tangent off the ordinary U0 vector
amplitude_gauge_and_score.residual_vector: three non-anchor components of anchored z_lattice-z_CLE
amplitude_gauge_and_score.secondary_crossing: anchored 12|34 tangent at lambda equals anchored 14|23 tangent at 1-lambda on the symmetric frozen grid

batch_sufficient_statistics_schema.covariance_rule: recompute probabilities and all three measure-score covariances inside each synchronized delete-one replicate
batch_sufficient_statistics_schema.cross_geometry_rule: share counter domains where geometry coupling is declared; otherwise retain block-diagonal covariance rather than inventing pairing

definitions.1234: all four marked vertices lie in one FK cluster
definitions.12|34: x1,x2 share one cluster; x3,x4 share a distinct cluster
definitions.14|23: x1,x4 share one cluster; x2,x3 share a distinct cluster

boundary_observable.other_terminal_partitions: recorded for normalization/debugging but zero in the primary three-vector

exact_continuum_from_source_and_parent_o: the inhomogeneous tangent ODE and universal sqrt(3)/pi exponent derivative
exact_finite_lattice: three link-pattern definitions and tiny four-cycle regression
separation of measure, bare/projector, field-renormalization and conformal-prefactor terms
claim_layers.scaling_hypothesis: finite square-FK boundary probabilities converge after L^(4h) renormalization to Cai's CLE connectivity vector

continuum_source.paper: Gefei Cai, Boundary four-point connectivities of conformal loop ensembles

integer_Q_fallback.primary_replacement: sample only Q=1 FK bond configurations and use the exact J/2 measure score
integer_Q_fallback.projector_validation_if_later_needed: at integer Q=2,3,4 color each FK cluster uniformly, regress the declared color-projector polynomial on the terminal partition, then differentiate that symbolic polynomial at Q=1; never finite-difference noisy Q runs

q_score_decomposition.conformal_prefactor_derivative: 2*h_prime*log(K)*G, kept separate and subtracted when forming d_Q log U
q_score_decomposition.explicit_field_derivative: zero for the bare indicators; renormalized boundary fields add 4*h_prime*log(L)*G plus an unknown lambda-independent normalization tangent
q_score_decomposition.explicit_projector_derivative: zero for the three plain connectivity indicators
q_score_decomposition.no_double_count_rule: use normalized continuum x_i and lattice spacing delta=1/L; log(L) belongs to field renormalization and log(K) to Eq. (1.4)
